name: dev-workflows
description: Full product-development lifecycle workflow skills for GitHub Copilot CLI: idea → create-vi → create-ard → specify → design → epics → implement → document → release-notes → ready, plus vuln (CVE remediation), upgrade, update-vi, api-guideline-reviewer, guideline-reviewer, docs-profile, feedback, and prompt utilities. Strong-tier model routing (Opus 5/4.8/4.7/4.6 or GPT-5.6/5.5), branch management, dispatched review sub-agents, and automated maintenance. Each phase hands its artifact to the next through the specs repo's default branch, and the consuming skill refuses to start until it has landed. Optional read-only grounding: on shipped product docs ($DOCS_PATH), on tracked vault prior art ($VAULT_PATH), on the counterpart space's docs for space-constrained document: runs, and on mounted code for idea: --ground-code. 20 user-facing skills + 34 sub-agents.
